ouranurgy.label: Postpone
ouranurgy.line: A blow that gets past your shield cracks you 4 seconds late.

ouranurgy.label: Hasten / Stay
ouranurgy.line: matter's time over a patch runs four times as fast, or stops

ouranurgy.label: Recall
ouranurgy.line: Blink back to where you stood 3 seconds ago, your pool as it was then if it was fuller.

ouranurgy.label: Portal
ouranurgy.line: a linked pair of holes: what goes in one comes out the other

ouranurgy.label: Swap
ouranurgy.line: two patches of ground trade places

ouranurgy.label: The Fuse
ouranurgy.line: Fuse the nearest foe. For 8 seconds, every affliction you put on it is delayed. Press again and they all go off at once, each lasting half again as long.

ouranurgy.label: Enhanced Postpone
ouranurgy.line: A parried Postponed blow lands at a quarter of its damage, down from half.

ouranurgy.label: Stopped Hour
ouranurgy.line: The epic miracle of the dread sign, drawn with Shift.

ouranurgy.label: Stasis
ouranurgy.line: A bubble where time runs at a fifth.

ouranurgy.label: The Rewind
ouranurgy.line: The area put back as it was 6 seconds ago. You keep only what you know.

manifestation.label: Plating
manifestation.line: Set 20 of your pool solid over the part of you facing the nearest foe: it takes most of that part's next crack.

manifestation.label: Sculpt
manifestation.line: raise a pillar, an arch, a bridge or a ramp of clay

manifestation.label: Footholds
manifestation.line: Set a step of Lachrymite where you are about to be: under your feet in the air, a stair ahead on the ground.

manifestation.label: Lock
manifestation.line: set a creation so the mending leaves it be

manifestation.label: Weather Anchor
manifestation.line: hold a miracle's weather on one spot for a game hour

manifestation.label: Catch the Weather
manifestation.line: Stand in a feeling's weather, out under the sky, with a Bottle on, and the Bottle fills with that feeling.

manifestation.label: Enhanced Plating
manifestation.line: Plating absorbs its region's whole next crack. It cannot stop a blow that would shatter you.

manifestation.label: Volcano
manifestation.line: The epic miracle of the fury sign, drawn with Shift.

manifestation.label: Made of a Feeling
manifestation.line: A made thing of a feeling: a wall of Grief's rain, a ward of Fury's sparks.

manifestation.label: A Second Vessel
manifestation.line: A clay double made from your pool, with its own cracks.

divination.label: The Watch
divination.line: A Figment's watch shows: while its head is down, how long until it looks up.

divination.label: Layer View
divination.line: see the layers under the hand

divination.label: A Body's Make-up
divination.line: Lock on to a creature and you read what it is made of, and so the type that bites it.

divination.label: Flow Preview
divination.line: see where a pour will run before it falls

divination.label: Scan Intent
divination.line: see a creature's next intent from above

divination.label: True Odds
divination.line: See chance as real numbers. Near the Tithe's console you get the next pull's odds for each tier, pity included. Near a crystal you see what it might give.

divination.label: Enhanced Watch
divination.line: A Figment's watch can be read from 50 m, up from 30 m.

divination.label: Prophecy
divination.line: The epic miracle of the wonder sign, drawn with Shift.

divination.label: Call It
divination.line: Commit to a read of a creature's next move. Right, and your read is exact a while.

divination.label: See the Next Roll
divination.line: Your own dice's next throw shown before you commit, once a game hour.

psychokinesis.label: Scoop
psychokinesis.line: take matter up and pour it out

psychokinesis.label: Shatter
psychokinesis.line: A Figment whose shell is near breaking glows; a heavy blow on it then breaks it at once.

psychokinesis.label: The Catch
psychokinesis.line: Parry a shot and keep holding the parry: you catch it, and let go to throw it where you aim, half again as hard.

psychokinesis.label: Lift Ground
psychokinesis.line: lift a slab of ground and set it down elsewhere

psychokinesis.label: Enhanced Catch
psychokinesis.line: A caught shot can be kept for 2.5 seconds, up from 1.5.

psychokinesis.label: Relay
psychokinesis.line: Hit a creature hard and the force carries on to the one behind it, up to three in a row.

psychokinesis.label: Hard Return
psychokinesis.line: A caught shot thrown back deals double damage, up from 1.5 times.

psychokinesis.label: Maelstrom
psychokinesis.line: The epic miracle of the desire sign, drawn with Shift.

psychokinesis.label: Heft
psychokinesis.line: A carried mass held off your pool's top, thrown as hard as it weighs.

psychokinesis.label: Banked Motion
psychokinesis.line: Your speed stored as you move and let go as one blow.

possession.label: Receptivity
possession.line: A mind whose agitation is in its best band shows open, and you may reprogram it without stunning it first.

possession.label: Herd
possession.line: creatures near a drawn line walk it

possession.label: The Link
possession.line: The last creature you reprogrammed is bound to you: a crack meant for you is split, half on it.

possession.label: Rally
possession.line: hatched clapperjars carry matter where the hand points

possession.label: Borrow a Verb
possession.line: Reprogram a creature and you can use its move on R for 20 seconds, in place of your sub's.

possession.label: Enhanced Link
possession.line: The linked creature takes two thirds of each crack meant for you, up from half.

possession.label: Stampede
possession.line: The epic miracle of the mirth sign, drawn with Shift.

possession.label: Ride
possession.line: Leave your vessel standing and drive a creature's body.

possession.label: No Border
possession.line: A bound spirit's pool and yours are one.

alteration.label: Shape
alteration.line: raise or lower the ground; Shift to level it

alteration.label: Re-type
alteration.line: For 20 seconds the tool in your hands strikes as another type: the nearest creature's weakness if you know its kind, else the next type in turn.

alteration.label: Transmute
alteration.line: sand to clay and back; a pool to your draught's feeling

alteration.label: Reactions
alteration.line: Paint one feeling over another and they react: opposites cancel to bare ground and calm what stands there; two that wedge flare as the old paint's blow.

alteration.label: Enhanced Reactions
alteration.line: Reactions reach 2.5 m, up from 1.5 m.

alteration.label: Walk the Cycle
alteration.line: Turn every affliction on the nearest foe into the one it beats: doubt into charm, charm into confusion, confusion into a stun, blindness into doubt.

alteration.label: Lasting Reactions
alteration.line: A cancel calms everything inside it for 5 seconds, up from 3.

alteration.label: Earthquake
alteration.line: The epic miracle of the gall sign, drawn with Shift.

alteration.label: The Exchange
alteration.line: Pool into mending, or a crack into pool, at a loss.

alteration.label: Re-make a Body
alteration.line: A creature's make-up changed a while.

spellscription.label: Miracles
spellscription.line: draw a feeling's sign to call its weather down

spellscription.label: A Standing Rule
spellscription.line: Write one rule: when you do one thing, another follows, for 5 of your pool.

spellscription.label: A Vow
spellscription.line: Swear off one thing and every cost is a quarter less while you keep it. Break it and it cracks you.

spellscription.label: Copy Terrain
spellscription.line: copy a patch of terrain and press it down elsewhere

spellscription.label: Enhanced Standing Rule
spellscription.line: A standing rule costs 2 pool to fire, down from 5.

spellscription.label: A Seal on a Creature
spellscription.line: Seal a creature as it winds up a blow. The blow breaks off, and it can't use that kind of blow for 20 seconds.

spellscription.label: Enhanced Vow
spellscription.line: A kept vow cuts every cost by a third, up from a quarter.

spellscription.label: Deluge
spellscription.line: The epic miracle of the grief sign, drawn with Shift.

spellscription.label: Rewrite a Tag
spellscription.line: Add a tag to a thing, or take one off.

spellscription.label: A Place's Law
spellscription.line: An inscription that changes one rule inside its circle.

reactionsWide.label: Enhanced Reactions
reactionsWide.line: Reactions reach 2.5 m, up from 1.5 m.

catchLong.label: Enhanced Catch
catchLong.line: A caught shot can be kept for 2.5 seconds, up from 1.5.

ruleCheap.label: Enhanced Standing Rule
ruleCheap.line: A standing rule costs 2 pool to fire, down from 5.

postponeDeep.label: Enhanced Postpone
postponeDeep.line: A parried Postponed blow lands at a quarter of its damage, down from half.

platingWhole.label: Enhanced Plating
platingWhole.line: Plating absorbs its region's whole next crack. It cannot stop a blow that would shatter you.

watchFar.label: Enhanced Watch
watchFar.line: A Figment's watch can be read from 50 m, up from 30 m.

catchHard.label: Hard Return
catchHard.line: A caught shot thrown back deals double damage, up from 1.5 times.

linkDeep.label: Enhanced Link
linkDeep.line: The linked creature takes two thirds of each crack meant for you, up from half.

reactionsCalm.label: Lasting Reactions
reactionsCalm.line: A cancel calms everything inside it for 5 seconds, up from 3.

vowDeep.label: Enhanced Vow
vowDeep.line: A kept vow cuts every cost by a third, up from a quarter.
